jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an illustrated interactive medieval tear-off wall calendar for the Gwynthor fantasy noticeboard. Generate ONE isolated calendar, straight-on front view, centered in a square 1:1 image with transparent alpha outside silhouette. Reference 1 is the exact scene and lighting in which it will hang on the lower horizontal wooden beam, between other small notices. Reference 2 is its matching hand-painted poster material and linework. This is a NEW asset, not an edit of either reference. Match crisp dark brown illustrated outlines, simple matte ochre parchment, softened warm lantern highlights from the upper left, muted amber/tan/brown, subtle hand-painted paper texture, shadow only directly behind the item. Design: a narrow portrait-format thick little block of overlapping parchment calendar leaves, about 3:4 overall silhouette, visibly handmade, lightly uneven edges, gently curled bottom-right corner, reinforced short dark wooden binding across the upper edge, one hammered iron nail through a leather hanging tab above it. The nail is visible and will be aligned with a horizontal beam in the app. No surrounding beam or scenery. The actual face of the front paper must be entirely BLANK and spacious for dynamic day numbers, month and year to be drawn by the app. Keep the front central paper area clear from 20% to 80% of image width and 28% to 86% of height. Very restrained thin border lines only near outer edge. No modern office-calendar spirals, plastic, glossy buttons, bright white paper, fantasy jewels, characters, decorative seals, numerals, letters, words, watermark, fake checkerboard. Readable, natural handmade prop at small scale, no photorealism or 3D render. True transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a TEN-GLYPH transparent numeral sprite sheet for a handmade medieval fantasy calendar UI. Reference 1 defines the scene's ochre/brown illustrated mood. Reference 2 defines the strong hand-drawn brown-ink letterforms and subtle rough edges. NEW transparent sprite sheet, not an edit of the references. Exact layout: square canvas, a perfectly regular 5-column x 2-row invisible grid. Each of 10 equal cells holds exactly ONE standalone numeral, centered, identical cap height and baseline relative to its cell, wide transparent gutters. TOP ROW left to right: 0 1 2 3 4. BOTTOM ROW left to right: 5 6 7 8 9. All ten digits must be complete, separated and recognizable, no extra marks. Style: hand-inked late medieval merchant ledger numerals, heavy clean dark walnut-brown ink (#302013 approximately), slightly irregular thick brush pen serifs, modest old-world character, strong legibility at small size. Digit 1 has a top flag and foot, 4 is open, 7 has a small crossbar, 0 clearly oval. Matte almost flat ink with only extremely subtle hand-painted stroke variation. No paper, no cell backgrounds, no colored tiles, no frames, no scenery, no shadows, no embossing, no shine, no labels, no punctuation, no letters, no additional numbers. TRUE transparent alpha background everywhere between the ink strokes including counters. Keep every numeral well inside its own cell so the atlas can be split into ten separately usable PNGs.
